stem: Which statement describes how the GI Bill affected the United States during the 1950s?

options.label: A
options.text: The act allowed members of minority groups to join the armed forces because it desegregated the military.

options.label: B
options.text: The financial regulations in the act protected the deposits of bank customers.

options.label: C
options.text: The educational benefits included in the act helped provide training to military veterans.

options.label: D
options.text: The act provided employment opportunities for women because it made discrimination in the workplace illegal.
